text:
marta: heads-up folks, running a targeted sweep of the new quantized-ggml intake today. want to lock down which signals the compatibility sentinel should block on vs just surface. saw some tokenization variance in a quick run.
jen: question  do we treat tokenizer differences as a blocker or a soft warning?
raj: tokenization diffs alone = soft alert. generation semantics divergence on canonical inputs = block. tokenizers can vary by pip/env.
sam: +1 but we need numeric thresholds or reviewers will be inconsistent.
marta: proposed flow: cheap prefilter at intake -> mini-bench (50 samples) -> full deepbench (512) only for flagged models. prefilter rules: cheap token-length/hash check (cpu) to catch obvious mismatches. if token count delta > 10% -> prefilter-fail and enqueue mini-bench. sentinel semantics: alert if top-1 token mismatch on >3% of golden set; hard fail if generation metric delta (avg perplexity/ROUGE per onboarding spec) >5% on 512 sample.
jen: can prefilter be even cheaper? maybe a fingerprint of token ids for first 64 tokens rather than full tokenization each time.
raj: implementation note: use tokenizer.encode(text[:512]) and compare len + a 32-bit fingerprint of token ids. ignore raw byte packing and endianness issues. if mismatch, route out-of-band.
jen: sketch of prefilter snippet: ```python
# intake prefilter (example)
ids = tokenizer.encode(text[:512])
fingerprint = zlib.crc32(bytes(ids[:64]))
if abs(len(ids)-gold_len) > gold_len*0.1 or fingerprint != gold_fp:
    mark_prefilter_flag(text_id)
```
sam: suggested sentinel thresholds (first pass): alert @ 2% perplexity delta, warn @ 5% generation token F1 drop, hard fail @ 7% perplexity OR crash rate >0.5%. include an operator_override label for infra-caused failures.
raj: keep 'compatibility' separate from 'performance'. latency regressions should be surfaced but not block admission unless they violate SLOs. admission gates should prioritize correctness/semantic parity.
build-bot: CI: deepbench/sample-512 for quantized-ggml finished  pass_rate=0.97 avg_perplexity_delta=1.9% compare=golden. details: https://ci.internal/deepbench/4325
jen: can we surface that CI link in the sentinel evaluation trace/UI so reviewers can open the full run? add a reproducible command in the flag payload.
marta: UX ask: when sentinel flags a model include a short repro command (curl + docker run) that executes the same mini-bench locally. reduces back-and-forth.
raj: technical gotcha: some quantized runtimes reorder sub-byte packing. base fingerprint on token ids not raw bytes; use canonical little-endian normalization for any packing checks.
sam: action items: (1) raj -> prototype CPU prefilter and PR to intake by EOD, (2) sam -> add sentinel threshold config to admit schema and defaults, (3) jen -> update onboarding doc to formalize tokenization-as-soft-fail rationale + mini-bench flow, (4) marta -> 15m review tomorrow to validate prototype outputs.
marta: i'll post invite and include quick checklist. if prototype shows false positives we iterate. :thumbsup:
